rules.name: capabilities
rules.check: Unique known IDs; each used operator/consumer requires its declared capability and exact registry signature. No unknown foo/1 or duplicate.

rules.name: values
rules.check: ids only inside assignRef.values; outputId only within export emit.fields/parent (no allocation-dependent selection); create.fields scalar-only; concat/case/stripPrefix only strings.

rules.name: selectors
rules.check: Table §2.2 order; property required only for reference/inverseReference, optional for children, forbidden otherwise. Binding domain must support traversal.

rules.name: bounds
rules.check: count min <= max, reachable minHops <= maxHops; all computed numbers finite, integer outputs safe.

rules.name: symbols
rules.check: Unique IDs/names in each namespace, all referenced notions/recipes/messages/resources/themes/glyphs and bindings exist; recognition/theme/extends dependencies acyclic.

rules.name: authority
rules.check: Every action maps to declared writes below and ratified effective producer rights; known containment/reference/scalar paths and target types. The checker receives the pinned base, applies explicit producerDelta and descriptor extension-field authority, and rejects a phase actor absent from the resulting field producer set.

rules.name: identity
rules.check: allocated/containment agree with effective id admission; ownerId resolves to string; no guessed immediate-parent owner.

rules.name: lint
rules.check: Exactly one validation record per stage/policy, all standard settings and applicable profile subrules present; resolver allowlist and options schema exact.

rules.name: presentation
rules.check: Explicit group/facet, glyph shape and token types, parameter signatures, theme binding uniqueness; no conflicting notion token assignment.

rules.name: UI
rules.check: Every required recipe parameter supplied exactly once by typed gesture/field bindings; enums have nonempty choices with unique JSON values (even when choice names differ), references have target types, readonly has no command.

rules.name: export
rules.check: emit kind has only its required/optional IR fields with correct types; artifact key/domain/parent valid; loss mapping §10.2.

rules.name: migration
rules.check: Target is literal self, source is an external pin; reject self source, own digest pin or unsupported recipe phase.

rules.name: bind fallbacks
rules.check: In recipe steps and rule bindings, presence of fallbacks requires cardinality first; [] is still a supplied fallback field. Schema conditional plus compiler preflight.

rules.name: action phases
rules.check: Each action must belong to the phase set in the authority table; schema recipe conditionals and compiler preflight agree. Export cannot mutate semantics.

actions.normalizeCondition: specifically approved structural support move only

authorityComposition: producerDelta replaces named from actor with to; absent from refuses profile-producer
precedenceScope: Phase dependency only. R3.3 does not define a total tie-break between simultaneous static failures; this table does not invent one. Specialized CR-13/14 codes remain the normative mappings even when schema conditionals detect them.
lexicalDependency: R3.3 section 2.1.1 normative codes and recursive first-failure order
